title: Ohio Flight Center

R22: SFAR 73 Endorsement or 10h dual with OFC Instructor, 200h in helicopter

blurb: Guests can rent advanced aircraft including Cessna 172N, Cessna 182RG, Robinson R22, and Robinson R44 with required pilot certifications and checkouts. Charter services include helicopter and King Air 90 (currently unavailable) flights for business, leisure, and cargo with flexible point-to-point access. They also offer all-inclusive luxury airtrip holidays with private flights, lodging, chef, and guided tours.
extraNote: Flight review within 24 months required · Block rate discounts available · Dry Blockrate hours allow paying fuel and oil separately · King Air 90 currently not available for charter · Lorain County Regional Airport (KLPR)
